ei.title: McLuhan's View on Media and Social Change
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: While the content of radio, television, or the internet might be a football game or a political debate, the message — in McLuhan's terms — of each of these media is not that. The message is instead equal to the social changes that a medium generates. McLuhan wrote that 'the "message" of any medium or technology is the change of scale or pace or pattern that it introduces into human affairs'. He also argued that the content of a medium is always another medium: the content of television might be the medium of a theatrical play, the medium of football, and so on. He wanted to make the point that by just studying the content, we risk becoming entangled in this spiral of media within media. It was therefore better, he thought, to instead focus on understanding media in terms of the ways in which they transform the social.

He also argued that the content of a medium is always another medium: the content of television might be the medium of a theatrical play, the medium of football, and so on. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①equally(부사←equal 형용사 보어) ②generates(동사) ③introduces(동사) ④better(형용사 비교급)
det.analysis:
① equally: The message is instead equally to the social changes → is의 보어 자리이므로 형용사 equal이 맞음. 부사 equally는 틀림 ←정답
② generates: a medium generates → 3인칭 단수 현재형 적절
③ introduces: that it introduces into human affairs → 관계사절 동사 3인칭 단수 적절
④ better: It was therefore better → 비교급 형용사 보어 적절
det.tip: be동사(is) 뒤 보어 자리 → 형용사 equal (부사 equally 불가)

He wanted to make the point that by just ②<u>studying</u> the content, we risk becoming entangled in this spiral of media within media. It was therefore ③<u>more better</u>, he thought, to instead focus on understanding media in terms of the ways in which they ④<u>transform</u> the social.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①might be(조동사+원형) ②studying(동명사) ③more better(이중비교급←better) ④transform(동사원형)
det.analysis:

② studying: by just studying the content → 전치사 by + 동명사 적절
③ more better: better는 이미 비교급이므로 more를 붙이면 이중비교급 오류. better 단독이 맞음 ←정답

det.korean: ①content(내용) ②generates(생성하다) ③commercial(상업적인←theatrical 연극의) ④entangled(얽힌)

det.korean: ①equal(동일한) ②content(내용←scale 규모) ③studying(연구하는) ④transform(변형하다)
det.analysis:
